chapter: Classical roots and the future of jazz
title: Jazz with symphony orchestras and playing silent pictures
summary: Armstrong says his band sat in with Bernstein's orchestra and says jazz and symphony should play together. He tells a story about accompanying an Indian-tribe scene in a silent film.
